prompt:
Image 1 is the camera and pose guide: a grey clay maquette rendered from the game's battle camera, with the moss on its back painted in the god's colour. Copy from it exactly the camera angle, the direction the beast faces, its pose, and its size and place in the frame. Do not copy its smooth clay surfaces, its simplified shapes or the thickness of its limbs: the anatomy, the face and every ornament follow Image 2 and the description.
Image 2 is this god's own approved painted portrait: paint the same beast, with the same shapes, colours, materials and marks, now seen full length from above at the battle camera, in the same painting style. Do not copy its dark background, its candlelight or its framing.

One large painted beast, full length, alone in the image on a perfectly flat, uniform pure green (#00FF00) background, as a game cutout. Pose: standing four-square and heavy at rest, its great head carried low and forward below the line of the shoulders, the club tail hanging behind the haunches.

Camera: high above and behind, looking down at about 40 degrees, the way a player looks down at a miniature on a table; orthographic, with no perspective. The beast faces away from us, toward the upper right of the image: we see its back, its right flank and the top of its head from behind; its face is mostly hidden. It is foreshortened as seen from above: its back and head are large, its legs short.

Light: outdoor daylight; the beast stays as dark and as muted as in its portrait, lit only by small warm and cool highlights, never washed out or brightened. A high sun in the upper left of the image lights the top of the head, the upper surfaces and the upper-left side of the beast with warm highlights; a cool blue-grey sky fill lies in the shadows on the lower-right side. No candlelight, no dramatic dark shadows, nothing glows unless the description below says so. No cast shadow on the background.

Painting style: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, moderate detail, the same hand as the painted portrait; a muted earthy palette with the god's own colours as its portrait shows them, in which the moss on its back in dull ember-orange (#C4532C), the Cinder Horde's colour is the one clear hue; soft painterly edges, with small crisp highlights on metal edges and a thin bright rim of light along the upper-left edges of the beast. The beast has a strong, simple, readable silhouette that still reads when it is shrunk to 120 pixels tall. It is not a cartoon: no cel shading, no thick black outlines, no chibi or big-headed proportions, no glossy 3D render, no pixel art.

The god: the Primordial, a colossal ancient beast-god from before the world was young, slow and vast. Colours: muted and earthy. The one clear colour of the beast is the moss on its back: a thick crust of dry lichen and moss that is entirely a dull ember-orange (#C4532C), the Cinder Horde's colour, rust-orange all over, with no green in it. Nothing in the image glows. No other saturated area larger than a small clasp or trim.
Body: a massive, heavy four-legged beast like a great primeval bull crossed with a giant ground sloth, with a deep chest, a high humped back and thick pillar legs with blunt claws; its hide is brown (#7A5638), thick and wrinkled, mottled with irregular patches of lichen grey-green (#909080). Head: the massive, low-slung skull of a primeval bull or bison, never a sheep or a goat: a heavy bony brow ridge, small deep-set furious dark eyes, a broad flat muzzle with wide nostrils, a deep jaw with a shaggy dark beard beneath it. Horns: a pair of huge, thick, ridged ram's horns that sweep back from the brow and curl forward around the sides of the skull, framing the heavy bull face. Back: its hump and spine are overgrown with a thick mantle of moss, a thick crust of dry lichen and moss that is entirely a dull ember-orange (#C4532C), the Cinder Horde's colour, rust-orange all over, with no green in it. Tail: a short thick tail ending in a heavy bony club as large as its head, studded with blunt knobs and clearly visible behind the haunches.

Size: the beast fills about 86% of the image along its longest side, placed as in Image 1, with at least 24 pixels of clean background all around; nothing is cropped.

Background: one flat pure green (#00FF00) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor, vignette or shadow. No green anywhere on the figure: no green cloth, no green glow, no green reflections; any lichen grey-green trim stays a pale grey.

Never: text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, frames, signatures, logos; a floor, ground, scenery or cast shadows; blood; other creatures or people; a cropped figure; smoke, flames, sparks, floating embers or mist.
